fields.title: Week of Nov 2 – Nov 8
fields.headline: Projected overrun $1.48M; Sales EMEA is the one cost center at risk.
fields.body:
**Projected overrun: $1,480,000.** **11 of 16** cost centers on track.

**At risk**
- **Sales EMEA** — three early hires and two early office openings.

**Watch**
- **Marketing Demand Gen** — paid search over plan for a second month.
- **Data & AI** — GPU usage rising after the beta.

**Forecasts older than 30 days**
- **Data & AI** — last refreshed Oct 14.
- **Legal** — last refreshed Oct 9.

fields.title: Week of Nov 9 – Nov 15
fields.headline: The year is forecast $2.36M over budget; 3 cost centers are at risk.
fields.body:
**Projected overrun: $2,363,000 on a $65.8M budget (3.6%)**, up from $1,480,000. **9 of 16** cost centers on track, down from 11. **Open POs: $4.44M.**

**At risk**
- **Sales EMEA** — score 18, $572K over. Early hires and offices. Action: budget transfer from Sales NA by Nov 20.
- **Marketing Demand Gen** — score 26, $512K over. Paid search 40% over plan; three sponsorships without a budget line. Action: cap search at plan.
- **Data & AI** — score 36, $432K over. GPU usage tripled. Action: refresh the forecast — **overdue since Nov 13**.

**Forecasts older than 30 days**
- **Legal** (38 days) and **Facilities** (35 days) — refresh booked for Nov 20.
- **Data & AI** (33 days) — at risk as well.

**Decisions for Thursday’s spend review**
1. Approve or cancel Demand Gen’s three sponsorship POs.
2. Approve the $350K transfer to Sales EMEA.
3. Hold the Q1 GPU reservation until January’s price change.
